name: Rubino TLR

origin.basis: Italian bicycle-tire brand; Vittoria's international store is set to Italy (EUR).

manufacturing.basis: The store pages do not state where the tire is made.

positioning: Vittoria's everyday training tire in tubeless-ready form, with a Graphene + Silica compound.
weight_basis: Vittoria store weights for black sidewalls; tan is 10 g lighter.

availability.note: Sold by Vittoria's international web store in euros; mainland China and North American availability not verified for this line.

price_observations.conditions: Official store price incl. Italian VAT on 2026-11-01; shipping calculated at checkout. One tire.

caveats: Owner reports found on XHS concern the earlier tube-type Rubino Pro and are not applied.
Bicycle Rolling Resistance's 2016 Rubino Pro Speed test is not applied.

image.shown: Rubino render from Vittoria's product page; Vittoria shows the same render for the TLR and tube-type versions, and the construction is not visible.
image.alt: Vittoria Rubino road tire render with red Vittoria sidewall logo

rights.usage_note: The maker's own product photo, shown from the maker's website; no copy is stored or redistributed by this project, and no license is asserted.
